Results.ReviewText: The class of all purpose grilling/smoking. I currently own 5 Weber grills ranging from the 14” Smoky Joe, to the 26”.
Results.Title: Owning Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: My only issue was the bottom portion came chipped but you guys sent a new one immediately and thus the 5 star rating. As far as the grill goes, it’s absolutely awesome it gives me awesome temperature control, it’s light and easy to store. I’m a huge fan of the catch can which makes cleaning a breeze. Overall the meat I have been making has been noticeably more flavorful than what came off my previous grill and I attribute that to the excellent ability to control heat.
Results.Title: Awesome sauce

Results.ReviewText: Love it. Had one before and its my favorite grill.
Results.Title: Love it.

Results.ReviewText: We have owned Weber kettle charcoal grills since 1976. Wouldn't own anything else!!
Results.Title: Only grill we would ever buy!

Photos.Caption: Made my own table for it…Thanks Instructables

Results.ReviewText: First of all I did not have to spend an hour or two putting it together. 15 minutes and I was done. I can slow cook ribs or I can quickly do some burgers or dogs. The thermometer really helps a lot. It’s easy to move around and easy to clean. I just love it. Thanks Weber.
Results.Title: Money well spent

Results.ReviewText: Great grill easy to keep constant temp when smoking using snake method achieved over 8 hours of cooking time.
Results.Title: Smoking

Results.ReviewText: I have been grilling on Weber kettles for decades and will not grill on anything else they are just that good. My last one was a 22" performer but since we are moving into an RV we needed something more compact that could travel so i bought a new 22" premium. As always the Weber kettle delivers and this new one is as well built and works fantastic.
Results.Title: Weber kettle = best grill ever

Results.ReviewText: Overall the grill performs great.  Even though my lid was damaged during shipping, it doesn’t effect the cooking.
Results.Title: Great grill

ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for your feedback. It is important the briquettes are lightly covered with gray ash. Once they have washed over, begin preheating the grill. 

Put the lid on, and let the grill set for approximately 10-15 minutes to allow the grill to preheat properly.

We would like to hear more about this experience. Please lookout for an email from our Support team.
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: Good quality but having difficulty keeping the fire going.  After half hour I gave up and did my burger in the house.  I'm not giving up.
Results.Title: Yes and no

Results.ReviewText: I couldn't be happier. I owned a Weber before then was talked into a gas grill...What a MISTAKE! I am so happy to have a REAL grill once again! There is absolutely NO substitute for a Weber!
Results.Title: Nothing but a Weber for me

Results.ReviewText: I love that the my new grill is quick and easy to use.  Unfortunately, the ash pan has falling off twice and I have not been able to get it to fit securely.  The wire ash pan handle does not fully expand to fit securely into grooves that should keep it in place.
Results.Title: Ash pan

Results.ReviewText: The Classic.  Great for controlling heat and easy clean up.  Craftsman quality and well constructed.  Great for the novice to the pit master.
Results.Title: A classic

Results.ReviewText: buy one.  they make a quality product. My last weber lasted over 20 years.
Results.Title: weber or not

Results.OriginalProductName: Barbecue au charbon Original Kettle Premium 22 po
Results.ReviewText: À date très satisfait. Facile à utiliser et donne de super résultats
Results.Title: Très satisfait

Results.ReviewText: I have used this as a grill and a smoker. It’s holding up good.
Results.Title: Good grill

Results.ReviewText: Easy to put together, first time Burgers and sausages    came out great!
Results.Title: Easy construction and great grilling

Results.ReviewText: The best thing i buy this year !! I wish i had it before
Results.Title: Everyday friend

Results.ReviewText: Love the unique copper color - makes barbequing fun!  Works really well and easy to use.
Results.Title: Awesome copper color

Results.ReviewText: I like it. It works fine. Easy clean up. I am not a grill master.
Results.Title: It's a good grill

Results.ReviewText: Spacious, comfortable, easy to use and exceeds expectations in performance. Everything anyone needs in a bbq at a very likable price.
Results.Title: Ease to use

Results.ReviewText: The original is still the best. Cooks food perfectly, and there are so many tips online about cooking with it. Love the new features, especially the ash dump bin.
Results.Title: My good old/new grill.

ClientResponses.Response:
We apologize for your frustration, that is not the experience we want our loyal Weber fans to have.

Here at Weber, we stand by the quality of our products and cover them under great warranties. Our main goal is to have you love our products just as much as we do.

We would like to hear more about this experience. Please lookout for an email from our Support team.
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: Seems flimsy and the lid had a small scratch on it. Clearly quality isn’t priority # 1
Results.Title: Quality Lacking

Results.ReviewText: Awesome product. Very consistent and easy to operate.
Results.Title: Cooks fast.

Results.ReviewText: My first weber lasted 17 years i now own 3 others i would recommend any weber product to anyone they just work and work well customer service is second to none i wish more company's were like Weber my next purchase will be a 26 inch model
Results.Title: Great company great product

Results.OriginalProductName: Barbecue au charbon Original Kettle Premium 22 po
Results.ReviewText: Je me sert juste de celui là je veux lui rajouter quelque accessoire
Results.Title: Je l adore je le conseil à tout le monde

Results.ReviewText: Super easy to clean the ashes with this bad boy. Love it.
Results.Title: Easy cleanup

ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for your feedback regarding the thermometer and the ash catcher assembly. We will be sure to share this with our team for consideration.

We would suggest using an oven mitt to grip the ash catcher handle when removing it. 

Your satisfaction is very important to us. Our Support team is reaching out to follow up. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: Very happy with 2 exceptions. Why have they been putting the thermometer opposite the vents for all these years? I have yet to hear from someone who likes this idea. The ash pan is difficult for me to remove and replace with mild arthritis. Otherwise I love it.
Results.Title: excellent with 2 problems for me

Results.ReviewText:
Love the grill! Wish it was about 2-4'' taller but I'm a tall guy!
This bad boy keeps stable temperature!
Results.Title: Awesome grill!

Results.ReviewText: Still trying to figure out some of the changes that have been made to this grill
Results.Title: Octogenarian griller

Results.ReviewText: Easy, quick and even grilling. Everything assembled easily and it's sturdy, only reason I gave it 4 instead of 5 is the hingeless top. My grilling space doesn't work well with the hooking system so I added a hinge and it's perfect.
Results.Title: Worth every dime.

Results.ReviewText: This is my 3rd Weber charcoal grill in over 25 years. Absolutely the best grilling experience!
Results.Title: Keep on grill'n

Results.ReviewText: Works great as advertised! Bought this for the lake house and happy I did.
Results.Title: 1st Charcoal Weber Grill

Results.ReviewText: I’ve owned 3 Weber kettle grills over the past  30 yrs and the are simply the best versatile grill you can own. I’ve got gas grills and smokers as well but if I could only have one, I’d choose my kettle over the others.
Results.Title: Simply The Best

Results.ReviewText: Again a great value and color! My 5th Weber kettle.  Now I'm collecting my favorite colors. Great grills Customer for life!
Results.Title: Amazing Kettle

Results.ReviewText: Although the lid and grate was damaged from the store, Weber customer service (thanks Andres!) had replacement parts sent right away.  This is my 4th Weber and, like the others, is great.  I would highly recommend the grill to anyone looking for a charcoal one.
Results.Title: Great Grill and Great Customer Service

Results.ReviewText: Excellent as always. Been on the gas train for many years and decided I want to disembark and get back to the tried and true Weber kettle. I’m Irish so I had to go with the green.
Results.Title: Finally back to charcoal.

Results.ReviewText: I've had this a few months now. It's a nice addition to my offset smoker and pellet grill. I don't have time (dad) to babysit an offset smoker all day but still wanted to smoke with charcoal and wood chunks, so this kettle grill is an awesome addition to my inventory. It's a nice break from the pellet grill and I feel like the stereotypical dad now!
Results.Title: Nice addition

Results.ReviewText: Gas grill features on a charcoal grill! Heat shield under the lid handle. Lid hinge is slightly hard to navigate at first. Temperature gauge that’s rarely found on a charcoal grill. Easy post-grilling clean-up.
Results.Title: Iconic charcoal grill with new age features

Results.ReviewText: When you are either starting out, or transitioning from LP to coal, there is a learning curve. Timing, temperature, ventilation and how much coal to use are all elements to learn. I suggest starting out with simple things like burgers and brats before you move up to more complex meals.
Results.Title: Transitioning from LP to coal.

Results.ReviewText: Muy buen asador pero la pintura comenzó a desmerecer en la tapa
Results.Title: Weber 22

ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for your feedback! We are happy to hear you are enjoying your 22" Original Kettle Premium grill but yet understand your disappointment with the damper rusting. 

Here at Weber, we stand by the quality of our products and cover them under great warranties. Our main goal is to have you love our products just as much as we do. 

Our kind Support team would like to follow up with you everything is still going well with the new parts. Please be on the lookout for an email, thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: it's a perfectly acceptable grill.  i guess the best part is the support from weber.  the bottom damper rusted shut and the louvers broke after about 5 years which was pretty disappointing.  however, after a lengthy phone call and several back and forth emails, i was able to get the replacement parts to fix it for free. i don't know why they asked me to review my new weber because it's like mostly new, and some old.  i cobbled the new parts w/the parts that still functioned on my old one and i have a franken-weber that's similar to new and i love it.
Results.Title: the truth

Results.ReviewText: I am loving it.  It is so easy to keep the right temp. And everything is cooked perfectly.
Results.Title: Easy cooking

14401001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
